result.title: Expandable Modality Experts for Medical Vision-Language Learning
result.comment: 11 pages (main text), 42 pages (supplementary material), 2 main figures. Submitted to ICLR 2027
result.summary: Learning across medical imaging modalities requires making use of images without paired text and accommodating new domains while retaining existing representations. We propose a medical vision-language technique built around an expandable bank of modality experts. Its Multiway Transformer combines shared visual computation with deterministically routed feed-forward experts and a separate text pathway. A modality-aware visual tokenizer supplies targets for masked pretraining on 19.4 million unpaired image rows across seven modalities; contrastive alignment then uses 3.23 million image-text pairs. Additional fundus and optical coherence tomography experts learn from paired data while the original image and text embedding paths remain frozen. With a ViT-Large backbone, the proposed technique achieves the best or tied-best result in 24 of 25 benchmark settings across nine modalities: 10 of 11 zero-shot classification benchmarks, all 10 linear probes, and all four retrieval benchmarks. Mean balanced accuracy is 0.674 for zero-shot classification and 0.856 for linear probing, and mean bidirectional retrieval recall is 20.70%. A separate three-seed sequential experiment with matched adaptation data yields fundus and OCT retrieval gains of 14.95 and 9.31 percentage points, with no measured loss on preceding fundus or pathology tasks. The preservation argument requires unchanged existing computation paths and inference conditions, and feature-identity checks verify retention on evaluated inputs. The proposed technique provides a modular approach to learning and expanding medical vision-language representations.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出面向医学影像的可扩展模态专家库：以 Multiway Transformer 共享视觉计算、按确定性路由接入前馈专家并保留独立文本通路，先用模态感知视觉 tokenizer 在 1940 万无配对图像上做掩码预训练，再用 323 万图文对做对比对齐，并通过冻结原有图像与文本路径新增眼底与 OCT 专家。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「冻结既有计算路径、按模态确定性路由扩充专家」的容量扩展与保持机制，可能可供核查：LVR 中新增视觉证据或新模态时，如何在不覆盖既有 latent 表示的前提下扩展状态容量与路由。
